proposed_capability: P95 design + P124 single-owner factoring + P62 regression evals + P83 gap review: durable guards for the 2026-11-09 Servo Evil/laundry-fire incident. Extend the existing diy_skill_force owner with (a) trait_repair console plan for the selected Sim (traits.remove_trait trait_Evil; traits.equip_trait trait_Good only on explicit operator request), (b) reward-dialog policy that classifies harmful reward traits (Evil) and never blind-OKs them (ESCAPE_CANCEL or HOLD only), (c) ui_forbids: Escape as household-traverse console close (Ctrl+Shift+C instead), Escape spam (opens Travel map / pause MENU), creating/activating a new Servo without explicit operator consent, CAS gender Continue when Escape-cancel was requested. Extend household_upkeep with Servo fire-risk laundry policy (durability critical/broken/unverified blocks laundry autonomy until Repair/Tune Up; dryer lint trap clean / Lint-Less Handiness upgrade; clothesline preferred when unsupervised). Extend decision_eval + decision-prompts with a CAS Continue-vs-Escape-cancel prompt and mandatory Send Alone when host work is active. No second trait daemon.
operator_correction: A prior agent activated a NEW male Servo (the operator's 'mail' was the male homophone), made him Evil, and he caused fires via low Durability plus laundry. The operator wanted Escape-cancel, not creating/activating that Servo. Skill-force ACCEPT_OFFERED_REWARD_TRAIT must NEVER blind-OK Evil/harmful traits. Escape spam opens the Travel map / pause MENU - encode durable forbids. Laundry dryer lint fires - encode Lint-Less / clean lint / clothesline preference for Servo households. Household skills are still not fully leveled - strengthen the durable path; no live PASS without Skills panel LOCAL_OBSERVED. School Join vs Send Alone: Send Alone is mandatory for host work.
player_save_control_impact: Library plans and policy evaluators only (execute_allowed=false). No live execute path is added for trait_repair. Never edits saves, never creates or activates a Sim, never presses Escape or Enter on its own. Does not close BI-002 or BI-005. Player-directed yields stay first.
expected_outcome: diy-skill-force contract v10 (trait_safety, trait_repair, ui_forbids, reward_dialog_accept harmful policy); diy_skill_force planner functions classify_reward_trait/decide_reward_dialog/plan_trait_repair/evaluate_ui_action; CLI trait-repair plan + reward guard that refuses Evil; household-upkeep contract servo_fire_risk + laundry_policy output; decision-prompts CAS prompt + host-work Send Alone; offline falsifier tests; docs/LEDGER/PROMPT_INVOCATIONS entries.

Unidentified reward dialog -> HOLD (NEEDS_DIALOG_IDENTIFICATION), no input
trait_repair default plan emits traits.remove_trait trait_Evil and no equip_trait
equip trait_Good without explicit operator request -> GOOD_TRAIT_REQUIRES_OPERATOR_REQUEST
Escape as household-traverse console close -> forbidden, use Ctrl+Shift+C
Escape spam -> forbidden (opens Travel map / pause MENU)
Activate/create new Servo without operator consent -> forbidden
CAS Continue when Escape-cancel was requested -> forbidden
Servo durability critical/broken/unverified -> laundry autonomy blocked, repair/tune first
Unsupervised dryer without Lint-Less and with clothesline available -> clothesline preferred
Under host work, school Join is never recommended; Send Alone is
No BI-002/BI-005 close claim, no save edit, no second trait daemon
rollback_path: Revert the feature-branch commits; contracts stay append-style (version bump only); no game files or user saves touched; prior diy_skill_force, household_upkeep and decision_eval behavior remains reachable via git history.
unresolved_unknowns: Exact live console id accepted for removing Evil (trait_Evil) is documented from community cheat lists - needs LOCAL_OBSERVED on the installed build
Whether the Lint-Less upgrade and clothesline objects are present depends on installed packs and Handiness level - observation-gated
Reward-dialog classification needs a fresh observation of the dialog title/trait text; no OCR owner is added here
Household skill levels remain UNPROVEN until Skills panel LOCAL_OBSERVED after PLAY_BRIEF_OBSERVE_REPAUSE
decision_rationale: Single-owner extension of existing diy_skill_force, household_upkeep and decision_eval; every new behavior is a fail-closed library policy with offline falsifiers and an explicit proof ceiling. Live trait removal, household skill leveling and the Send Alone dialog remain independently gated local-host observations.
